description: A `failure` memory is transferable for the same reason a `procedure` is: it describes something going wrong and how it was resolved, not what this project happens to be configured with.

candidate.title: A test suite deadlocks on a pool query inside an open transaction
candidate.problem: A query taken from the pool while a transaction is held blocks until the pool times out.
signals: pool timed out while waiting for connection
test hangs then fails far from the cause
applicability: the configured default address pools are actually exhausted
candidate.root_cause: The code path takes a second connection while holding the first.
candidate.approach: Pass the open connection down instead of reaching for the pool.
constraints: existing networks are not migrated to the new pool
verify the ranges are genuinely exhausted before changing daemon config
